Highlights & benefits

Tax Exemptions

Qualifying SVG LLCs are structurally exempt from corporate, capital gains, and withholding taxes on all income generated strictly from international business activities

Exceptional Corporate Privacy

Robust confidentiality laws ensure that the identities of company members and managers are strictly protected and legally shielded from public registries

Accelerated Setup Timeline

Following the successful submission of all compliance documentation, the official government LLC registration is systematically finalized within five to seven working days

Integrated Local Representation

The incorporation framework natively integrates the mandatory first-year registered agent and registered office services required for ongoing statutory compliance

Comprehensive Documentation

The setup issues a complete digital corporate kit, encompassing the operating agreement, setup resolutions, and official corporate records

FAQs

What is a Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (SVG) LLC?

An SVG LLC is a highly flexible offshore corporate structure designed for international business, combining the limited liability protection of a corporation with robust privacy and tax advantages

What are the primary tax benefits of an SVG LLC?

Under Sections 91 and 92 of the LLC Act, a qualifying SVG LLC is fully exempt from corporate, capital gains, and withholding taxes, provided all business activities are conducted strictly outside the jurisdiction.

Is public disclosure of LLC members required in SVG?

No. SVG enforces strong confidentiality laws that legally ensure the names of LLC members and managers are never disclosed on any public registry.

Do I need a local resident director to form an SVG LLC?

No. There are absolutely no local residency requirements for shareholders, members, or directors in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.
